system.history:
A rescue professional trained for fire, structural hazards, vehicle incidents, and civilian evacuation.

Scene use: Rescue leader, hazard expert, trapped ally, evacuation coordinator, or source of practical information about a damaged location.
system.personality: Decisive, team-oriented, and willing to enter danger for others. Prioritizes rescue and containment over pursuing an enemy.
system.distinguishingFeatures: Protective turnout gear, helmet, radio, breathing equipment, and rescue tools.

system.description: A heavy rescue tool that can serve as a close weapon in an emergency.
